Settings
All data and settings are stored on this device and never go anywhere else.
How this app works → What's new →
Light theme
Switches from the default dark look to a light one
Show Kanji content
The Kanji section isn't part of the course — on by default
Half credit for hinted answers
Using a hint before answering halves the confidence boost for a correct answer
Fade confidence colours over time
Also fades the colours themselves over time, not just drill odds — off by default
Work offline
Caches the app so it still opens with no signal
Untaught vocabulary
Trip words and phrases (start with Tourist essentials), real Japanese from photos, and any private word lists — outside the taught course, off by default
Activate Andrew mode
Staging area for whatever's next — currently empty
Back up my progress
Saves your scores to a file you can restore later
Private vocab
Add extra word lists from a file, kept on this device only (e.g. textbook vocab that isn't part of the shared app).
